parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A single wheel of the cart made of rubber, typically circular and attached to the base for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the cart’s movement and allows it to roll smoothly across surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main frame and shelves of the cart made of steel, providing structural support and load-bearing capacity.
parts.Functional_description: Holds and supports items placed on the cart, connects to the wheels for mobility, and includes a handle for pushing or pulling.
parts.Movement_description: Remains stationary relative to the wheels; moves as a whole when the cart is pushed or pulled.
